tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: A table's dimensions in key order, its coverage dates, and its options. Dimensions with up to 64 options list them inline with labels; larger ones (geography, occupations) say how many and are searchable with search_options.

tools.name: search_options
tools.description: Find option codes by label text within one dimension of one table — e.g. a suburb name in a geography dimension. Returns codes to use in get_data's select.

tools.name: get_data

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_data, execute, feedback_form · Private data: search, execute, feedback_form, submit_feedback · Public sink: feedback_form, submit_feedback · Destructive: search, execute.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_data, execute, feedback_form · Private data: search, execute, feedback_form, submit_feedback · Public sink: feedback_form, submit_feedback · Destructive: search, execute

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tables" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
